summary: Today brings a mixed regulatory and market outlook driven by state enforcement against quick-commerce food operators alongside rapid structural shifts in FMCG retail channels. In-house counsel should focus on food compliance mandates, employment notice precedents from the High Court, and strategic tech moves by major retail competitors.

bullets.text: Maharashtra FDA suspended 105 food business licences, including outlets linked to Blinkit and Zepto, ordering seven closures following pre-Diwali inspections.
Calcutta High Court ruled newspaper advertisements constitute valid recruitment notice, confirming portal reopenings for corrections do not extend original application deadlines.
E-commerce's share of India's FMCG retail sales has tripled over the past two years, according to data from Nielsen.
Reliance Jio is holding exploratory tech-for-equity talks with US cable and telecom operators Comcast and Charter Communications.
Amazon launched a text-based shopping feature on Alexa enabling customers to research products, track prices, and automate purchases.
